verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs describe several natural-language control surfaces. The web editor has a built-in agent that edits pages, reorganizes navigation, updates docs.json and manages dashboard settings. A Slack agent (@mintlify) answers questions and opens PRs from thread context. An admin MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor edit pages, update settings and open PRs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these agents work as claimed, evidence that operations such as deployments, domains and analytics can be driven by natural language rather than only content and settings edits.
